title: Key config
description: KEY CONFIG names each action in turn, with its key under CURRENT, and each key press binds the one shown: W twice binds UP and DOWN, Escape twice keeps LEFT and RIGHT, Space twice binds JUMP and ACTION, E twice SWITCH and RUN, and Q twice BOMB and ROPE, leaving PURCHASE.
